## Default Permission

Permissions par défaut du plugin AdMob : init du SDK, affichage de rewarded ads, options de confidentialité UMP.

#### This default permission set includes the following:

- `allow-initialize`
- `allow-show-rewarded-ad`
- `allow-privacy-options-required`
- `allow-show-privacy-options`
